nodes.text: @RishikaSadam In most cases, these symptoms are mild and resolve within a few days to a week. However, HMPV can lead to more severe respiratory illnesses, such as bronchiolitis or pneumonia, especially in young children, older adults, and individuals with weakened immune systems.
